name: base

secretsDescriptions.BASE_RPC_URL: RPC endpoint used to submit transactions to the Base network.
secretsDescriptions.BASE_DEPLOYER_PRIVATE_KEY: Private key for the wallet that pays deployment gas and owns the deployed agent.

verificationStrategy: After running deploy.sh, manually confirm the health endpoint returns 200 and check the deployment log for a successful startup message. Do not consider the deployment verified until both checks pass.
